thread:
nora_sales: Heads up 7/12 Acme Corp dry-run at 09:30 PDT. They requested a short hosted QPS increase to handle an expected spike ~1200 qps for ~8 minutes. Can we approve an ephemeral scoped key and a temporary quota bump?

diego_infra: Need exact UTC window and region. Also which model/seq len and whether they have an IP range.

nora_sales: Window: 16:30-16:38 UTC (that's 09:30-09:38 PDT). Region: us-west-2. Model: gpt-open-2, avg seq ~450 tokens. IPs provided: 203.0.113.16/28. No PII to be sent.

sam_ops: We can do hosted bursts but prefer prep ticket. Please include desired qps, TTL for key, and fallback plan. Ops can raise to 1300 qps for that window if no other scheduled events.

maya_security: Ephemeral key TTL max 30m; recommend 15m. Must enable audit logs, and add token revocation post-window. Confirmed we need CIDR only, no open access.

leo_engineering: Suggest pre-configuring a fallback to quantized-model variant and enabling KV prefix caching for repeated prompts during the demo to reduce load. Ops: any objections?

sam_ops: No objection. We'll set policy to route overflow to quantized-2x if sustained >1s queue. Also we'll enable per-request throttling so users see 429s gracefully.

ticket-bot: Created ticket SUP-8799: ephemeral key + temporary qps bump.

sam_ops: SUP-8799 approved for provisional increase to 1300 qps for 8m. Nora, please paste the ephemeral key into the ticket — do NOT post keys here.

nora_sales: Adding key to ticket now. TTL set to 20m. Notifying Acme about the IP lock and revocation plan.

leo_engineering: Small note: for demo graphs, enable trace sampling at 100% during window so Acme can get detailed latency breakdowns. We'll turn it off after.

maya_security: Also request a short attestation in ticket that Acme won't send customer PII. Good to have for audit.

sam_ops: All done. SUP-8799 updated: QPS=1300, window=16:30-16:38 UTC, fallback=quantized-2x, audit logging enabled, token TTL=1200s, revoke after window.

nora_sales: Thanks team 44D — looping in Acme and will confirm if they need extended window (will file new ticket if so).
